notes: The district was unchanged in the December 2025 reorganisation (The Hindu). The official Divisions page (last updated 19.04.2022) lists 15 mandals in 2 divisions, matching the home page counts (updated 15.10.2026). The Divisions table spells 'Seetampeta', while the constituencies page and mandal maps use 'Seethampeta'; 'Seethampeta' is used here. The ULB list (2 municipalities and 1 nagar panchayat) comes from the MoHUA PMAY-U 2.0 list and matches the '3 Towns' on the district home page.
